item.description:
The following steps can reproduce the dmesg error on Rockylinux10.1:

# mount.lustre XXX.XXX.XXX.XXX@tcp:/test /mnt/test/
# umount /mnt/test/
[449857.792313] Lustre: Mounted test-client
[449861.185976] LustreError: 281843:0:(lov_obd.c:780:lov_cleanup()) test-clilov-ff45ff4eca88c800: lov tgt 0 not cleaned! deathrow=0, lovrc=1
[449861.209983] Lustre: Unmounted test-client
